metadata.title: Phase 08 Acceptance Criteria Evaluation (A through Q)

criteria.target: Zero regressions in existing test suite

criteria.target: Remaining time derived from authoritative arrival timestamp

criteria.target: ARRIVED locked at 0.0m; immune to delayed packets

criteria.name: Documented and Tested API Contract
